title: norvidrate
blurb: a currency converter to and from norvids — 1 norvid is pegged to the dollar cost of running xbill against @norvid-studies.bsky.social's own repo (X's read-API rate card, $5/1000 posts), recomputed once a day. shimmermathlabs.com: "do you really think we want a normal currency converter?"
